metadata.name: Verdant Ziggurat
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A lost temple in a misty jungle clearing: a stepped temple of carved relief stone with its shrine and golden idol on top, Mayan guardians at its gateway, an overgrown court before it and the jungle closing in over ruined walls. Caves to the west where the roof comes down behind you; a rock ridge with vines up to a sniper walk over the waterfall; a river crossed by a sagging rope bridge, a stone slab bridge and stepping stones; a giant tree with a zipline from its lookout down to the temple; a watch tower in the south-east. Grapples at both ends.

do.text: Verdant Ziggurat. Watch your step on the bridge.
